name: Kyoei Steel Ltd.
summary: Kyoei Steel Ltd. engages in the manufacture, processing, and sells of billets and steel products in Japan, Vietnam, Canada, the United States of America, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Domestic Steel Business, Overseas Steel Business, and Environment and Recycling Business. The company offers concrete reinforcing bars; merchant bars, such as flat bars, I beams, equal angle bars, and round bars; billets; and threaded rebars and joints for threaded rebars. It is also involved in the collection, transportation, and treatment of general, industrial, and medical waste; and manufactures and sells casting products.
